THE FRAME'S SOUND. THE OLD CLOTH PANELS AREN'T. WE
NEED FABRIC AND CLIPS.
I CAN HELP.
HELP ME DO YOUR JOB, OR ASK ME TO DO MINE?

TONIGHT'S STYLING. A TRIAL. WE CAN DISCUSS FUTURE
WORK AFTER WE'VE TRIED WORKING TOGETHER.
GOOD. TONIGHT, AND MY EQUIPMENT COMES BACK.
YOUR EQUIPMENT COMES BACK.

I'D LIKE TO WORK WITH YOU TONIGHT. LET'S SEE HOW
THE TRIAL GOES.
A CLEAR BRIEF. I FIND THOSE VERY ATTRACTIVE.
PROFESSIONALLY.
AT THE MOMENT, WE'RE DISCUSSING A SCREEN.

I'D ENJOY DOING THIS WITH YOU. TONIGHT'S STYLING,
WITH YOUR EQUIPMENT RETURNED.
SO WOULD I. WE'LL MAKE THE ROOM USABLE.
SO NOBODY NOTICES THE STYLING.
I DIDN'T SAY INVISIBLE, JACKIE.

I'D LIKE YOUR HELP TONIGHT. AND I'D LIKE TO SEE
YOU PERSONALLY. I'M TRYING TO ASK THOSE IN
SEPARATE VOICES.

GOOD. IF YOU ASK ME OUT, TRY NOT TO OPEN WITH
"DOES THIS FOLD?"

THE PERSONAL INVITATION IS SEPARATE FROM TONIGHT'S
WORK.

THEN LET'S DO THE WORK. WE CAN TALK ABOUT THE
INVITATION SEPARATELY.
FOLDING SCREEN FRAME

A SOLID FRAME. IT NEEDS CLOTH PANELS TO PROVIDE
PRIVACY. THE FRAME ALONE LEAVES VERY LITTLE TO THE
IMAGINATION.

DRAPE FABRIC OVER THE UPPER RAIL.
CLIP AT THE PAIRED DOT MARKS.
KEEP THE LOWER EDGE CLEAR OF FEET.
UPPER RAIL CLIP MARKS

PAIRS OF DOTS ON THE UPPER RAIL. THE DRAWING PUTS
THE CLIPS THERE AND LEAVES THE BOTTOM CLEAR.
CLEAN SPARE SHEET

A CLEAN SPARE SHEET FROM THE KITCHEN, LARGE ENOUGH
FOR THE SCREEN. FOR ONCE, "JUST THROW A SHEET OVER
IT" IS PROFESSIONAL ADVICE.
LARGE LAUNDRY CLIPS

LARGE LAUNDRY CLIPS FROM THE SIDE PASSAGE. THEY
GRIP THE FABRIC AT THE PAIRED DOTS ON THE UPPER
RAIL. IT'S A DRESSING JOB I CAN DO WITHOUT ANYONE
BREATHING IN.
VIVIAN'S SAMPLE LAYOUT

VIVIAN'S MODEL HAS AN ARRIVING VISITOR, RITA'S
DISPLAY AND THE KITCHEN HATCH, WITH TWO
SIGHTLINES. HIDE THE DISPLAY; LEAVE THE HATCH

VISIBLE. DINNER IS THE PART OF MY EVENING I WANT
INSPECTED.
ARRIVING VISITOR FIGURE

A CARDBOARD ARRIVING GUEST MARKS THE START OF THE
SIGHTLINE. NO OPINIONS, NO DIETARY ANNOUNCEMENTS.
I MAY ASK VIVIAN TO LEAVE IT.
DISPLAY FIGURE

THE SAMPLE LAYOUT'S STAND-IN FOR RITA'S COVERED
DISPLAY. THE ARRIVAL VIEW NEEDS TO STOP BEFORE IT
GETS HERE.
MINIATURE SCREEN TOKEN

PUSH THIS LITTLE SCREEN AROUND VIVIAN'S SAMPLE
LAYOUT TO SEE WHICH OF THE TWO SIGHTLINES IT
BLOCKS. VERY CONSIDERATE OF HER TO MAKE MY
MISTAKES SMALL.

THERE'S A CLEAN SPARE SHEET IN THE KITCHEN. YOU
CAN USE IT.
FOR VIVIAN'S SCREEN.

GOOD. I DIDN'T WANT TO BE THE LAST PERSON TO KNOW
WHAT THE SHEETS WERE DOING.
THE SPARE SHEET. FRANKIE SAID IT'S AVAILABLE.

LARGE LAUNDRY CLIPS. THEY'LL HOLD THE SHEET AT THE
PAIRED DOTS ON THE UPPER RAIL. I KNEW ALL THAT
LAUNDRY WAS PREPARING ME FOR GLAMOUR.

THE SHEET LIES OVER THE UPPER RAIL, WITH THE
BOTTOM CLEAR OF THE FLOOR. NOW IT NEEDS CLIPPING.

CLIPS AT THE DOTS, LOWER EDGE CLEAR. TAUT ENOUGH
TO HANG CLEANLY, LOOSE ENOUGH TO FOLD.
THAT LOOKS EXPENSIVE.
YOU'RE WELCOME.
COMPLETED SCREEN

A CLEAN SHEET CLIPPED TO VIVIAN'S FRAME, WITH A
CLEAR LOWER EDGE. THE CLIPS BELONG TO THE SCREEN
NOW.
THAT PUTS THE CLOTH ACROSS PEOPLE'S FEET.
IT DID LOOK RATHER SECURE.

TO THE PEOPLE. DRAPE IT OVER THE UPPER RAIL, THEN
CLIP AT THE DOTS.

THE ARRIVAL AND KITCHEN SIGHTLINES UPDATE WITH THE
SCREEN'S POSITION.

YOU'VE HIDDEN THE KITCHEN HATCH. WE'RE CONCEALING
RITA'S SURPRISE, NOT PROTECTING PEOPLE FROM THE
SIGHT OF DINNER.
I'LL MOVE THE SCREEN AND LEAVE THE HATCH VISIBLE.

THAT'S THE POSITION. ARRIVALS CAN'T SEE THE
DISPLAY; THE KITCHEN HATCH STAYS IN VIEW.
RITA GETS HER SURPRISE, AND I GET SEEN COOKING.

BOTH TEMPERAMENTS CATERED FOR. I'LL MARK IT ON THE
COURTYARD PLAN.

SCREEN: MARKED ALCOVE POSITION.
CONCEAL THE DISPLAY FROM ARRIVALS.
KEEP THE KITCHEN HATCH VISIBLE.
WITH YOU THERE, WHO'LL BE LOOKING AT THE SCREEN?
QUITE A FEW PEOPLE. I'M VERY GOOD.

NOW: WHAT JOB ARE WE AGREEING TO, AND HOW ARE WE
MAKING THE SCREEN STAND?

THERE'S AN INDUSTRY MIXER TONIGHT. I COULD TAKE
YOU. PEOPLE YOU'D WANT TO MEET.
THAT SOUNDS VERY TEMPTING.
IT IS. I'M GOOD AT INVITATIONS.

I'D LOVE ANOTHER OCCASION. I'VE PROMISED TO COOK
HERE TONIGHT.
ANOTHER OCCASION, THEN.
YOU'RE NOT DISAPPOINTED?

A LITTLE. BUT KEEP YOUR PROMISE HERE. THE MIXER
WILL SURVIVE WITHOUT US. EVERYONE THERE IS VERY
GOOD AT EXPLAINING WHY SOMEONE IMPORTANT HASN'T
ARRIVED.

IF THE HOUSEHOLD HAS FINISHED, WE CAN SEE WHAT'S
POSSIBLE AFTERWARD. I CAN'T PROMISE MORE THAN
THAT.
FAIR. SUPPER FIRST; AFTERWARD STAYS A POSSIBILITY.

IF WE MANAGE IT, I'LL BE THE ONE STILL SMELLING
FAINTLY OF ONIONS.

THE SCREEN'S YOURS FOR TONIGHT. WE'VE AGREED THE
JOB; THE LAYOUT WORKS.
THANK YOU. I'LL GET YOUR EQUIPMENT BACK TO YOU.
GOOD. LET'S PUT IT IN THE COURTYARD.

COMPLETED SCREEN MOVED TO THE COURTYARD. CLIPS
REMAIN ATTACHED.

MAKE THE SCREEN USABLE, THEN HIDE RITA'S SURPRISE
WITHOUT HIDING THE KITCHEN.

THE FRAME SHOWS THE UPPER RAIL AND PAIRED CLIP
MARKS. ON VIVIAN'S MODEL, WATCH BOTH THE ARRIVAL
SIGHTLINE AND THE KITCHEN SIGHTLINE.

AGREE TONIGHT'S STYLING WITH VIVIAN. DRAPE THE
SPARE SHEET OVER THE UPPER RAIL AND ATTACH THE
LAUNDRY CLIPS AT ITS DOT MARKS. MOVE THE SCREEN

TOKEN ACROSS THE DISPLAY SIGHTLINE WHILE KEEPING
THE HATCH SIGHTLINE CLEAR.

SIX FULL SUPPERS, OR EIGHT TASTING BOWLS USING THE
METHOD IN THE MARGIN.
WHAT'S A TASTING BOWL?
A SMALL PORTION WITH EYE CONTACT.

INCLUDING ONE FOR YOU. I WON'T HAVE YOU WATCHING
ME CHEW WHILE YOU EXPLAIN WHAT I'M TASTING.

EIGHT BOWLS. ONE OF THEM MINE. I'LL FOLLOW THE
MARGIN'S METHOD.
COURTYARD HOTPOT RECIPE

MY SIX-FULL-SUPPER RECIPE, WITH THE
EIGHT-TASTING-BOWL METHOD WRITTEN IN THE MARGIN.
SMALLER PORTIONS, LARGER ADJECTIVES. I MAY BE
MOVING UP IN THE WORLD.

COURTYARD HOTPOT: SIX FULL SUPPERS.
EIGHT TASTING BOWLS: ADD STOCK TO THE MARKED JUG
LINE. BASE FIRST, VEGETABLES SECOND; FINISH WITH
HERBS AFTER TURNING OFF THE HEAT.
BEAN-AND-TOMATO BASE

PREPARED BEAN-AND-TOMATO BASE FOR THE HOTPOT. IT
LOOKS MODEST NOW. WAIT UNTIL I DESCRIBE IT.
VEGETABLE BOWL

THE PREPARED VEGETABLES. THEY GO IN AFTER THE
BASE, BEFORE COOKING.
STOCK BOTTLE

STOCK FOR THE TASTING-SIZE RECIPE. MEASURE IT TO
THE JUG'S EIGHT-BOWL MARK. "A GENEROUS SPLASH" IS
HOW I END UP SERVING SOUP.
MEASURING JUG

A LARGE, UNMISTAKABLE MARK FOR EIGHT TASTING
BOWLS. INCLUDING MINE.
8 TASTING BOWLS
HERB SACHET

THE FRESH FINISH. THE PACKET SAYS TO ADD IT AFTER
THE HEAT IS OFF.
FINISH OFF THE HEAT
HOTPOT POT

A POT WITH A PROPER LID. COOK THE HOTPOT HERE,
THEN KEEP IT LIDDED IN THE KITCHEN UNTIL IT'S TIME
TO CARRY IT.
POT LID

A LID THAT FITS THE POT. THERE'S A REASON NEITHER
OF US IS SERVING SUPPER OFF THE FLOOR.
STOVE

ON TO COOK THE BASE AND VEGETABLES. OFF BEFORE THE
HERBS. A COOK SHOULD KNOW WHEN TO STOP HELPING.
THE BEAN-AND-TOMATO BASE IS IN THE POT.
FILL TO THE EIGHT-TASTING-BOWL MARK.
USE THE SIX-SUPPER QUANTITY.

RIGHT TO THE EIGHT-BOWL MARK. TASTING PORTIONS FOR
ALL EIGHT OF US.

STOCK MEASURED TO THE EIGHT-TASTING-BOWL LINE.
READY FOR THE POT.

THE MEASURED STOCK IS IN. THE BASE AND STOCK CAN
GO IN EITHER ORDER; THE VEGETABLES FOLLOW THE
BASE.

VEGETABLES IN. THE COOKING COMES BEFORE THE FRESH
FINISH.

BASE, STOCK, VEGETABLES. A SHORT COOK, AND THE
HOTPOT IS READY FOR ITS FRESH FINISH.
HEAT OFF. NOW THE HERBS.

HERBS IN AFTER COOKING, WITH THE HEAT OFF. A FRESH
FINISH, NOT BOILED PERFUME.
LID ON. EIGHT TASTING PORTIONS, READY FOR LATER.

MY RECIPE SAYS TO TURN THE HEAT OFF BEFORE ADDING
THE HERBS. APPARENTLY I WROTE IT FOR A MAN I DON'T
TRUST.
HEAT OFF FIRST. I'LL KEEP THE HERBS FOR THEN.

THAT'S STOCK FOR SIX, AND THERE ARE EIGHT OF US. I
CAN MAKE A TASTING PORTION ELEGANT; I CAN'T MAKE
TWO PEOPLE DISAPPEAR. REFILL THE JUG TO THE

EIGHT-TASTING-BOWL MARK SHOWN IN THE RECIPE'S
MARGIN.

THE HOTPOT IS FINISHED, BUT IT NEEDS ITS LID
BEFORE IT TRAVELS. I'D LIKE THE COURTYARD TO SMELL
OF SUPPER WITHOUT WEARING IT.

OH, JACKIE. THINKING ABOUT ALL THE LOVELY THINGS
RITA'S OFFERING US...
IT'S THE ONION.

OH. I WAS ONE HUG AWAY FROM PUTTING MY SLEEVE IN
THE BEANS.
I AM GRATEFUL TO HER, THOUGH.
I KNOW.

READY FOR EIGHT TASTING BOWLS. THE LID STAYS ON,
AND IT WAITS HERE UNTIL WE SERVE.

HOUSEHOLD SPECIAL READY: EIGHT TASTING PORTIONS.
LIDDED POT WAITING IN THE KITCHEN.

COUNT ALL EIGHT CONTRIBUTORS, INCLUDING JACKIE,
THEN READ THE RECIPE'S MARGIN.

USE THE JUG'S EIGHT-TASTING-BOWL STOCK MARK. THE
HERBS ARE A FRESH FINISH, ADDED ONLY AFTER YOU
TURN THE HEAT OFF.

PUT BASE, THE EIGHT-BOWL STOCK MEASURE, AND
VEGETABLES IN THE POT. COOK, SWITCH OFF THE STOVE,
ADD THE HERBS, THEN CLOSE THE LID. BASE AND
MEASURED STOCK CAN GO IN EITHER ORDER.
